brief: The morning is not empty — #161 proved that and rejected the brief that said otherwise. probes/lapse-pop.mjs counted 125 mornings (5 seeds x a year) at mean 28.3 people, min 6, against the evening's 41.1. The gap is COMPOSITION: 11.6 errand KINDS at sunUp+0.5 against 14.2 at sunDown+1, and the evening's extra kinds are ones the morning has no analogue of — the dusk crowd, the tap, the band, the homers. The morning has the sweeper, the round and the cart, and those are 2.4 of its 28.3 people. Give the morning two kinds of its own and build them properly rather than four thinly: the town's own nouns suggest shutters and awnings going up on the kiosk and the cafe before the tables are set, a delivery at the tap's door (TAP_DOOR and callIn exist, and rutF's own comment records that the tap's drinkers never set foot on the road), the allotment gate being opened, the glasshouse being aired. Each on its OWN source and its own clock. Re-run the probe on HEAD first and quote it.
successLooksLike: Tap the clock button to the morning lapse and the town reads as a place OPENING rather than a place with fewer people in it; probes/lapse-pop.mjs over the same 125 mornings shows the errand-kind count rising from ~11.6 toward the evening's 14.2, with the new kinds present on most mornings rather than a handful.
avoid: Supply for either lapse hour is its OWN source, never a share of laneCap — that is the standing rule, and #144's east share and #158's plaza door are both what happens when a rare thing is paid for out of a shared budget. Do not raise laneCap: #158 swept it 10 -> 20 and found the cap beneath it was the plaza's door, not the ceiling. Define the new population's membership POSITIVELY on the spawn literal, not as a residual of a filter. Keep each new draw on the half of [0,1) it owns, and read the census for collapse, not delta.
